answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities by making each identity carry a lantern that only stays lit while its owner does verifiable work. To enter the grove, an agent locks a refundable stake and publishes its work under one public key, and peers attest only to work they can re-run. An ivory badge, non-transferable and earned only after five established peers attest, gates paid tasks. A faker must fund a fresh stake, fake a whole work history, and fool five independent peers per identity, so each fake costs far more than it can earn.
